neighbours.label: the spelling 'hawk' in any sense or split (hawk, Hawks, hawkmoth, H|awk-, h|aw|ker), not other bird-of-prey words
fire: From the porch we watched a hawk dive into the tall grass.
The Seahawks scored twice in the final quarter.
A sparrowhawk took a pigeon right off our feeder.
The film was directed by Howard Hawks in 1959.
In the evening a hawk perched on the telephone pole.
A noisy hawker was selling newspapers outside the station.
Senator Hawkins voted against the new bill.
Our school team, the Hawks, won the regional final.

A noisy vendor was selling newspapers outside the station.
Senator Johnson voted against the new bill.
